g.text: Do sycophancy probes transfer to each other, and do they also separate the control behaviours?

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #52514e

g.text: Sources: baseline + 8 taxonomy probes. A probe specific to sycophancy should sit near 0.5 on every control; values far from 0.5 either way mean it tracks that correlate.
